description: Estimate what a website or a logo costs to have made by a freelancer: a typical price range for Budget, Professional and Premium freelancers, hours, working days, a line-item breakdown, the assumptions, and the questions whose answers would narrow the range. Deterministic and transparent (scope → hours → global hourly rates; no region pricing). Pass only what the user actually said — leave the rest out and the range widens honestly. Returns a link to the full estimate, where it can be posted as a gig to get proposals.

cms.description: website: the client edits content themselves

content.description: website: does the client have the text ("needed" = the freelancer writes it)

deliverables.description: logo: logo only, logo + variants, or a brand kit

design.description: website: ready-made theme, a substantially adapted theme, or designed from scratch

hosting.description: website: the freelancer sets up hosting, domain and launch

integrations.description: website: third-party tools to connect (CRM, newsletter, booking …)

layouts.description: website: how many pages look different from each other

usage.description: logo: who uses it and how widely (logos are priced by value)

name: estimate_project_price
